proposal:
## Next bounded AP02 candidate: native field conversion before async machinery

Source screen:FormatSuspendedFieldAsync is async even when its value is native
and only FormatInterpolatedStringPart runs. Seven direct callers span executable
and lowered fields plus existing urllib conversion;all immediately await/use the
ValueTask. This demonstrates unnecessary native state-machine participation,
not a proven heap allocation or elapsed bottleneck.

Proposed removal:make the outer helper a non-async ValueTask branch. Native
values invoke the same synchronous formatter immediately;only PyInstance values
enter the existing descriptor/protocol async body. Move that body,do not duplicate
formatting,add a second dispatcher or change the supported nested-container/
str.format IO boundary. Keep conversion/fallback/error ordering,argument storage,
awaited users,owners,fuel/span and G03 guards. An earlier synchronous native throw
must remain equivalent at every immediate-await caller/public boundary.

Acceptance:one frozen short native/control pair for text/int/conversions and
instance/descriptor/fault cases;allocation,funding,work/output/error spans must
match unless a justified difference is documented before promotion. Reuse real
protocol IO/cancellation,first-refusal/retained owners and58 jobs;include urllib
callers in focused semantics. No elapsed gain claim without measurement. Stop
at this helper and its direct callers;if ownership transfer,new callback modes
or a broader interpreter/dispatcher is needed,reject. No prototype/capture yet.
The Unicode formatter kernel and identity-removal family remain closed.
Pins:.git/agent-notes/unicode-format-d212c3fa/native-field-source-screen.json.
semanticBoundary: Keep existing async protocol handling;native branches currently run synchronously inside async helper. Existing nested-container/str.format IO restriction is preserved.
